name: Iridescent Seal of Metatron

description.content: Decreases [Punishment of the Damned] range by [50%].
Creating [Rites of Judgment] trails increases [Punishment of the Damned] range, up to a maximum of [200%].
This resets when [Punishment of the Damned] hits a Survivor.

quote: "This magic square, with strong protective and dispelling properties, is called the 'Virun VII Crest' or the 'Seal of Metatron'."
